title: What came between Anuradhapura Kingdom and Kingdom of Dambadeniya?
question: What came between Anuradhapura Kingdom and Kingdom of Dambadeniya?
claim: 2 documented links lead from Anuradhapura Kingdom (-377) to Kingdom of Dambadeniya (1220): 0 of cause and effect, 2 of succession.
why: Each record is joined to the one before it by a Wikidata statement (has effect, has cause, followed by, follows, replaced by, replaces), and the dates run forward. The longest such chain from the first record was taken, preferring cause and effect.
